items.text: Hello everyone! Thank you for playing and supporting Beast of Reincarnation. This is the 9th update since launch and addresses the following:
New Features & Gameplay Adjustments
Players can now change Emma’s outfit at Campsites and via the Bed Menu inside the Cleanse Walker.
Outfit pattern variations have been placed throughout each region. Once you acquire a new outfit pattern variation during exploration, you can change into it.
Added support for carrying over equipment, outfits, and skins when starting New Game+.
Added a "Growth Boost" feature to the Grow Chamber. Defeating enemies grants boost uses, allowing you to speed up crop growth.
Improved Grow Chamber behavior so that when the "Auto" setting is enabled, at least one crop seed is guaranteed to be planted if you own seeds.
Added new attack moves to bosses and adjusted their behavior/attack patterns.
Rebalanced overall stats and attributes for regular enemies and Nushi.
Adjusted the power of select Bloom Arts and Blade Arts.
Improved weapon handling so that ranged weapons can now be switched during regular attacks and while in Iaido stance.
Changed the Guard input to a continuous trigger (press and hold).
Improved attack targeting on slashes so that the pitch (vertical direction) aligns toward the targeted enemy.
Added “Entanglement Overdrive” to Key Config, supporting custom key rebinding and saving.
Improved key config warnings to alert players when assigned buttons conflict with key actions that cannot overlap (such as lock-on during ammo slot switching).
Added support for touchpad controls and button icon displays when using a PS5 DualSense controller.
Ongoing Improvements to Cutscenes & Events
Adjusted dialogue pacing and scene timing across various event scenes.
Fixed an issue where item and weapon acquisition pop-ups were not displayed correctly when skipping certain events.
Fixed visual corruption in cutscenes and event sequences when using ultrawide monitors.
Bug Fixes & Technical Improvements
Fixed an issue where the HP bar would disappear during combat when using ultrawide monitors.
Fixed an issue where aiming a ranged weapon while locked-on, with aim assist turned off, caused the reticle to drift significantly below the enemy.
Fixed an issue with ranged weapons where specific inputs caused loaded arrow types/ammo counts to mismatch in the bottom-right UI display.
Fixed an issue where achievements were not properly unlocked upon fully upgrading a ranged weapon.
Fixed achievement triggers so that they properly unlock even after performing a skill reset.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 3 where attacks would stop registering against the boss, causing progression to stall.
Fixed an issue under specific conditions where the "Blade Enthusiast" achievement failed to unlock.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 10 where an invisible wall spawned in front of the Nushi, preventing progression.
Fixed an issue in Chapter 11 where defeating the boss turned the field dark, causing progression to stall.
Improved Steam achievement checks so that the “Duty Fulfilled" achievement is properly verified upon returning to the Title Screen. (Steam)
Fixed an issue where selecting a Bloom Art command while Koo was downed caused the command menu to remain open indefinitely.
Fixed an issue inside the Cleanse Walker where camera movement became disabled, occasionally causing progression to stall after speaking with Kagura.
Fixed an issue preventing interaction with the crank outside Subcity 02.
Fixed an issue where skipping events at certain timings left background music permanently muted afterward.
Fixed an issue where doors that remained locked in previous versions failed to open properly.
Fixed an issue where chest icons in unvisited areas appeared on the map after skipping part of the story.
Fixed an issue where secondary exploration info markers remained duplicated or failed to display correctly.
Adjusted hitboxes and perfect guard timing windows for the Rangifer variant.
Fixed a stat display mismatch between the cooking bonus screen and item acquisition screen when equipping the “Double-Edged Sword” Spirit Stone.
Fixed an issue with the bed menu inside the Cleanse Walker where specific inputs caused the game to freeze or soft lock.
Fixed a visual artifact on the ROG Ally where certain event scenes and murals turned overexposed white.
Improved loading control on Steam Deck to prevent background asset pop-in and out-of-bounds falling caused by rendering delay.
Improved performance and optimized resource load across various visual effects.
Fixed visual glitches in various regions, including background tearing, shadow flickering, model clipping/gaps, and unnatural invisible walls.

As we mentioned in the last round of patch notes, this ninth update marks the end of our regularly scheduled post-launch update cadence. We want to offer sincere thanks to everyone who has played Beast of Reincarnation, shared feedback, submitted bug reports, and engaged with the community since launch. Your input has been critical in helping us improve the game, and we’re so grateful for all of your interest, patience, kind words, and constructive criticism.

Although this period of frequent updates is coming to an end, we are still here and listening. If you have any thoughts, feedback, or issues you'd like to share with the team, please feel free to do so here or reach out any time via the Fictions support site. And once more, thank you so much for playing!
-Fictions & Game Freak

Hello everyone! As always, thank you for continuing to play and share feedback about Beast of Reincarnation. Today’s update is the 8th since launch and contains the following:
Beast of Reincarnation PC Patch Notes (v1.1.01)
New Story Progression Option

After clearing the mid-game Great Wall Terraces Zone, players can now choose whether to bypass the three subsequent zones (Pilgrim's Zone, Matsukawa Colony Zone, and Fuji Frontier Zone) or play through them normally.

This option allows players who want to focus primarily on the story to reach the Capital faster, as well as give New Game+ players the flexibility to progress more quickly through the game during additional playthroughs.

Note: If you select "Hasten to the Capital," achievements obtainable in Pilgrim's Zone, Matsukawa Colony Zone, and Fuji Frontier Zone during a New Game run cannot be earned. However, these achievements can still be unlocked on a New Game+ run by selecting the Mountain Route.
Added a Field of View (FOV) adjustment setting in the Options menu.
Added an option to show or hide cutscene/event “skip” prompts in the Settings menu.
Event & Cutscene Improvements
Adjusted line pacing and staging timing across numerous event cutscenes.
Fixed an issue where dialogue subtitles remained on screen after skipping an event.
Fixed an issue where rapidly skipping certain events could cause the game to soft lock or become unresponsive.
Fixed an issue where character positioning or camera angles appeared unnatural after skipping an event.
Bug Fixes & Technical Improvements
Fixed an issue where manually canceling Entanglement Overdrive would inadvertently toggle target lock-on ON/OFF.
Fixed an issue where canceling a strongbox unlocking sequence while activating Koo's Bloom Art would cause the camera to lock onto Koo.
Fixed an issue where Koo would use items on staggered enemies.
Fixed an issue where the “staggered” (“絶”) graphic would remain on screen.
Fixed an issue where "Manual: Explosive Arrow" obtained from a Keeper Golem could not be obtained in New Game+.
Distributed effect generation processing load to improve overall game performance.
Fixed various environmental issues across all regions, including gaps in the environment, clipping models, and unnatural invisible walls.
Adjusted submersion detection depth and collision boundaries across all zones.

Lastly, we want to share that our current post-launch update cycle is coming to a close. Our next patch, currently planned for Oct 19th (final date TBD), will be the final patch in this ongoing phase of major post-launch updates. While frequent updates will be coming to an end, if you have any thoughts, feedback, or issues you'd like to share, please feel free to reach out to us or file a support ticket via the Fictions support website.

Once again, we’d like to thank all of you for your support and valuable feedback, which has helped us improve Beast of Reincarnation immensely over the two months since launch. And although we’re moving out of our post-launch update cadence, we hope to address any remaining major concerns, either in next week’s planned patch or a later update. Please feel free to make any final suggestions and ask questions below, and please keep an eye out here for any future announcements. Thank you all!
-Fictions & Game Freak

Hello everyone! It's been nearly two months since Beast of Reincarnation's launch, and we're very grateful to all of you who have played the game and taken time to share feedback. The team is still working on various fixes and adjustments, but today's patch (#7) includes the following:
Beast of Reincarnation PC Patch Notes (v1.1.0)
Expanded Difficulty Options
Added "Very Hard" mode, which is more difficulty than "Hard."
Added "Ruthless" mode, where Emma dies instantly in a single hit, as a bonus challenge mode for fans.

notes.title: Added increased difficulty options for New Game+

items.text: These options include "Hard", "Very Hard", and "Ruthless" modes for Reincarnation+.
Note: the default difficulty of Reincarnation+ mode corresponds to "Normal."
Note: you can switch between difficulty modes at any time during gameplay.
Various Gameplay Adjustments
Overhauled the attack patterns for some Nushi variants.
Updated some of Shidou's attack patterns, with further updates planned in future patches.
Added an auto-pickup feature for item drops from enemies and items in the field. This can be changed under the Gameplay tab in the Settings menu.
Adjusted the difficulty of certain bosses and enemies whose difficulty was lower than intended.
Adjusted ranged weapon damage dealt to bosses.
Adjusted the attack power of select Blade Arts Finishers and Bloom Arts.
Ongoing Improvements to Events and Cutscenes
Adjusted dialogue pacing and scene timing across numerous event cutscenes.
Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements
Fixed UI layout issues for players using ultrawide monitors and added proper support for ultrawide displays on the Skill Tree screen.
Mitigated buggy behavior on the map screen when using mouse input while a controller is connected.
Fixed an issue where the confirmation inputs did not work on certain items in the food production menus when using keyboard and mouse.
Fixed an issue on Steam Deck where loading delays when moving between specific areas caused the player to fall into the void.
Fixed an issue where the revive effect would not trigger properly if caught in consecutive self-destruct attacks while under the effect of "Resurrection Censer."
Fixed an issue where special abilities were not properly upgraded when upgrading to "Bell Sword +1."
Fixed an issue where crossbow reload enhancement values would reset when changing equipment.
Fixed an issue where parameter boost displays on the Cooking screen differed before and after equipping Spirit Stones.
Fixed an issue where selecting a greyed-out item in the equipment enhancement menu caused the controls to lock up.
Fixed an issue where specific button inputs while operating the bed menu on the Cleanse Walker resulted in soft locks.
Fixed an issue where Koo would use an item immediately upon departing from the Cleanse Walker.
Fixed an issue where the quantity of Koo's exclusive item, "Oil Container", was not displayed in the Item Box.
Fixed an issue where unnecessary UI elements or effects for items remained visible at spawn locations for hidden items that had already been collected.
Fixed an issue where vines did not disappear upon completing the battle against the Withered Beast.
Fixed issues in certain boss fights where attacks would fail to hit, enemies/players would get stuck in walls, or the camera would get cut off.
Fixed an issue where certain enemies would freeze or become unresponsive.
Fixed an issue where Emma's posture would tilt unnaturally while interacting with certain objects or standing on slopes.
Fixed unnatural invisible collision boundaries across zones.
Fixed an issue where the music, voiceover, or sound effects would cut off or fail to play during certain events or after fade-to-black transitions.

Thank you for your continued support and patience while we prepared this update. We are continuing to monitor feedback and make improvements in response. We expect to have more to share on further updates in the coming weeks.

Hello,
Thank you for playing Beast of Reincarnation! We have released a new update containing the changes and fixes outlined below. Additional patches will continue to be released in the future.
Beast of Reincarnation PC Patch Notes (v1.0.12)
Almost all event scenes and cutscenes are now skippable. (Note: A very small number of cutscenes remain unskippable for now, but these will be addressed in a future update.)
Added a "Skip" indicator to skippable cutscenes.
Finishing animations can now be skipped.
Previously viewed Tips will no longer display from New Game+ onwards.
Frame Generation options now adjust based on your GPU (RTX 40 / RTX 50 Series).
When using DLSS-Dynamic on a monitor with a refresh rate of 120Hz or higher, you can now set a target frame rate.
Added "Switch ammo slot 1–3" options to button mapping, allowing alternative controls for switching ammo.
Fixed an issue where skipping certain cutscenes immediately upon starting caused them to not end properly.
Fixed an issue where Emma’s dialogue lines did not always display correctly when the voice-over language was set to English.
Fixed an issue where the player remained trapped if they died at the exact moment they defeated enemies in specific event battles.
Fixed progression blockers related to event and boss battles across various zones.
Fixed an issue on physical disc versions where exploration info markers did not display correctly if playing without installing updates.

Thank you for your patience while we prepared this update. We are continuing to improve the game based on your valuable feedback. The following changes, among others, are planned for future updates and we’ll keep players informed as this work continues:

We are planning to introduce an option after clearing the mid-game Great Wall Terraces Zone that allows players to either bypass the three subsequent zones (Pilgrim's Zone, Matsukawa Colony Zone, and Fuji Frontier Zone) or play through them normally. This will allow New Game+ players to progress more quickly through the game, as well as give new players the flexibility to reach the Capital faster if they want to focus primarily on the story. Additionally, we plan to adjust existing zones, such as revamping attack patterns for similar boss types, to make them even more enjoyable. Details will be announced once finalized.
Revamping attack patterns for similar boss types (Nushi variants and Shidou).
Adding a difficulty mode higher than HARD.
Adding a higher difficulty mode for NEW GAME+.
Auto-pickup for items dropped by enemies.
Adjusting dialogue pacing and cut lengths during events.
Adjusting water hazard detection.
Adjusting invisible boundaries.

Hello,
Thank you for your continued support of Beast of Reincarnation! The team is still planning and working on additional patches, but this is the game’s fifth patch, which includes:

notes.title: Ongoing improvements to cutscene playback and pacing

items.text: Increased the number of skippable event scenes and cutscenes.
Select event scenes and cutscenes up to the Great Wall Terraces zone can now be skipped.
Note: we are continuing to implement skippable cutscenes throughout the game and anticipate that this work will be complete soon.
Adjusted dialogue pauses and cut lengths during certain event scenes to improve overall pacing.
Note: we will continue to make adjustments to improve pacing moving forward.
Adjusted playback conditions for certain event scenes and cutscenes.
Note: due to these playback adjustments, players currently mid-playthrough may experience a very small number of event dialogue lines playing twice.
Enabled Emma and Koo's alternative skins and cosmetic items to be visible during cutscenes.
Made the options to disable Film Grain and Chromatic Aberration available on non-PC platforms.
Made the option to disable Post-Processing in cutscenes available on non-PC platforms.
Enabled the ability to reset skills tied to the flower nodes of the skill tree.
Placed additional "Blighted Sprouts" that yield SP.
Enemy attacks now cancel upon initiating revival via Regeneration.
Enabled input buffering for aiming ranged weapons during various actions.
Adjusted the power of Magic Bullet skills after they penetrate enemies.
Adjusted various parameters for Blade Arts, Finishers, Nushi Skills, and ranged weapons.
Adjusted attack patterns and attack frequencies for certain Nushi.
Re-enabled acid pool generation exclusively for specific attacks from Corvus.
Adjusted the placement of "Breakable Amber" nodes in select areas.
Reorganized upscaling options (DLSS, etc.) to ensure appropriate default settings are applied based on the detected GPU.

notes.title: Miscellaneous bug fixes and technical improvements

items.text: Fixed an issue where Koo would detect items/objects that had already been interacted with or collected.
Fixed an issue where the numerical value associated with Koo's Pounce Rate was not displayed.
Fixed an issue where hitstun duration was increased when taking damage while aiming a ranged weapon.
Fixed an issue where "Decayed Charms" were capped at a maximum of 99, causing identified charms to be automatically converted into money if they exceeded this limit after appraisal.

Please note that for players who have already encountered this issue prior to this fix, we are unfortunately unable to restore the lost charms even after the patch is applied. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to those who inadvertently lost their charms. We deeply appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter.
Fixed an issue in the Cloud Streaming version where tutorials failed to progress under specific conditions.
Fixed an issue where certain event visual effects were cut off when using ultrawide resolutions.
Fixed an issue where Shido's Iaido Strike failed to register hits in specific positions.
Fixed an issue where specific event scenes unintentionally played twice.
Fixed an issue where the quantity and sell price for Spirit Stones were incorrectly displayed.
Fixed an issue where zooming in on empty space within the Map screen displayed a blank "Add Marker" window.
Fixed an issue where status effects and build-up icons with identical effects were displayed simultaneously.
Fixed areas where visible terrain features did not match invisible wall collision behavior.

Thanks again for playing, and for your patience as we continue releasing updates for Beast of Reincarnation! The team is still monitoring player feedback and bug reports, implementing additional fixes and adjustments, and planning for more updates in the future.
The following changes, among others, are planned for future updates and we’ll keep players informed as this work continues:
Adding a new difficulty mode above Hard.
Adding increased difficulty options for New Game+.
Auto-pickup functionality for enemy item drops.
Further increasing the number of skippable cinematics and cutscenes, as detailed above.
Further adjustments to dialogue pauses and cut lengths during cinematics/event scenes.
Further adjustments to water submersion hitboxes.
Further adjustments to invisible wall collision.

Hello,

Thank you for continuing to play Beast of Reincarnation, sharing your feedback, and waiting patiently for the game's second patch! The team is still working hard on additional updates, but today's patch includes the following:
Beast of Reincarnation PC Patch Notes (v1.0.8)
Added player camera distance options: Close, Medium, and Far.
Various further adjustments to the player camera, both in and out of combat.
Camera adjustments will continue as needed in future updates.
Adjusted certain in-game cinematic camera cuts.
Adjusted triggering conditions for events/cutscenes to reduce consecutive cutscene plays when moving between areas.

Placed additional objective markers along the progression route in the early story to make navigation clearer.

Adjusted water submersion detection.
This update applies adjustments to select areas only.
Adjusted combat behavior for some bosses.
Increased the damage and HP recovery amounts for Bloom Arts.
Changed one battle that takes place midway through the Fuji Frontier Zone to a scripted event.

Changed target lock-on behavior defaults to "OFF" for Auto-Target (Attack), Auto-Target (Parry), and Auto-Target (Switch).
This will not affect players who have already configured these settings. If you wish to change them, please do so manually in the options menu.
Shortened the main route in the Pilgrim's Zone.
You can now proceed directly to the Belfry without passing through the Cave or Stone Chamber areas.
Fixed an issue with the cloud streaming version of the game where delayed enemy spawns could block game progression.
Fixed an issue where performance would lag/drop significantly when activating the "End of the Line" skill mod on the Bloom Art: "Kiku: Bloom Strike."
Fixed an issue where unintentional audio/visual noise would appear in certain cutscenes.

Thanks again for your patience while we prepared this update! We have multiple additional patches planned, and we'll continue to make fixes and adjustments in response to player feedback. In upcoming patches, we plan to address several more common requests and points of feedback, including:
Implementation of skippable events and cutscenes.

This implementation has involved more technical challenges than initially expected, which is why it's taking some extra time. To deliver this feature as quickly as possible, we are considering adding skip functionality to cutscenes incrementally, in stages. We sincerely apologize for the delay and ask for your patience until we can share further details. Thank you.
Ultrawide monitor support.
This update is currently in the final stages of testing and will be released soon. We sincerely apologize for the wait and appreciate your continued patience.
Implementation of frame generation.
Allowing healing items to be used immediately upon taking damage, rather than after a small delay.
Reducing the duration of movement slowdown while Emma is healing.
Fix for an issue where text appears unintentionally scaled down in certain places.
Further boss camera adjustments.
Adjustments to water submersion detection.
Adjustments to invisible walls and collision boundaries.
Adjustments to event/cutscene presentation.
Fixes for an issue where Koo obstructs the player's view.
Fixes for an issue where landing positions can shift while leaping.

Hello Beast of Reincarnation players! Thank you for sharing your experiences with the game and providing thoughts and feedback during launch week. We have multiple additional patches planned, but today, the following changes have been made:
Beast of Reincarnation PC Patch Notes (v1.0.7)
Various adjustments to the player camera, both in and out of combat.
Additional camera adjustments will be made going forward.
Adjustments to text size throughout the game.
Further text size adjustments are being planned.
Story pacing has been slightly adjusted by ensuring that some of the affinity-building conversations that could occur multiple times in a row are now limited to once per day.
Additional updates are being planned to further improve cutscene experience. We will share more details as soon as possible.
The default cinematic cutscene setting has been changed from Cinematic to Performance mode. This means that cutscenes will not longer play at 24fps by default, though the option is still available.
Please note that if you already have this option set to Cinematic, changing it to Performance will apply this change going forward.
Players can now change the mapping of the "interact" button in settings.
Adjustments to the parry window when Emma is taking damage.

Fixed a bug where, if the interact button is mapped to the square/X button, pressing it during the story event where you talk to Kagura on the Walker would incorrectly prioritize "rest until morning", preventing you from talking to Kagura.
Various balance adjustments to bosses across all difficulty levels.
Various balance adjustments to enemy encounters on Normal difficulty.
Fixed a bug causing button icon type changes to not be saved correctly.
Fixed a bug causing upscaling settings to reset upon restarting the game.
Fixed a bug related to V-Sync. Changing V-sync settings will no longer impact the player's resolution settings.
Fixed an issue where the 6th golem in Subcity 01 was difficult to find.
Fixed an issue where Emma becomes unable to interact if a Bloom Art is cancelled.

Thank you for playing and patiently waiting while we prepared the first update. Multiple additional patches are planned, and various fixes and adjustments will continue to be made in response to ongoing player feedback. In subsequent patches, we plan to address common requests and issues, such as:
Implementation of DLSS 4/4.5 (L/M) and FSR4
Further small adjustments to story pacing
And much more
